profile.headline: Leadership is not domination. It is the art of persuading people to work towards a common goal.
profile.summary: Experienced Principal Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of leading projects and teams in the medical device industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in C/C++, QML, Linux, agile methods, and leadership.

company.name: Galil Medical, a BTG International group company

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Write embedded C on a legacy product to add new features and fix defects.
• Perform heavy unit testing on changes to verify everything works in accordance with standards and system requirements.
• Create documentation and reports for design history to meet customer and FDA requirements.
• Work with QA to create unit tests for the validation test plan.
• Create tools for the QA group to assist testing of the system.
• Create automated unit tests to exercise code paths and verify changes do not cause regressions.
• Conduct code reviews with team members and customers to make sure changes meet requirements and coding standards.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked as Scrum Master for team in Agile environment.
• Led a project as development lead on supportability feature.
• Worked on a Customer Focus Team which included troubleshooting customer issues as well as travelling to a customer site to assist in upgrading their system.
• Worked on feature teams to develop new features as well as create automated Unit, Component, or System tests.
• Mentored new hires and interns to help them better understand the role of Software Engineer as well as Developer for Symantec NetBackup.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
• Managed projects which included facilitating meetings, customer training, software implementation, and meeting customer deadlines  
• Work with customers to solve various hardware, firmware, and software problems
• Create SQL Queries and custom scripts for customers
• Perform customer training remotely and at customer sites
• Perform remote migrations of software and database for new servers
• Travel to customer sites to configure new substation equipment and diagnose various problems

positions.title: Automotive Technician/Service Consultant
positions.description:
• Diagnosed and repaired customer vehicles specializing in electrical and drivability
• Created test procedures to assist in diagnosing various problems
• Managed a team of four technicians while serving as night shift Service Consultant/Manager
• Assisted other technicians with diagnosis and repair of vehicles
• Communicated and solved problems alongside leadership as member of employee council
